mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 72 degrees at Verona City Hall with an air quality index of 57, so keep that in mind if you are sensitive to the moderate air quality.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will review several development projects on November 4th, including the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for 1979 Milky Way. Additionally, tax bill preparation is underway, with bills arriving by December 15th.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, or Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday.

Regarding public safety, the Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15th, an officer arrested a school bus driver for O W I after investigating reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported during the incident.
For dessert, Culver's of Verona is currently open and featuring the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie as today's flavor of the day. They remain open until 10:00 PM this evening for your convenience.
